mechanism_evidence.contract: Coordinates.__getitem__ returns an owned copy: the slice is not (is not) the original; slicing and mutating the slice leaves the original points/weights untouched; captured at the __getitem__ call timepoint.
mechanism_evidence.trigger: Slice a Coordinates object, then mutate the slice.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: new = self aliases the original; slicing mutates the original object.

discriminating_observation.description:
import numpy as np
import pyfar
coords = pyfar.Coordinates([0, 1], [0, 1], [0, 1])
new = coords[0]
print('slice_identity', new is coords)
assert new is not coords
new.set_cart(2, 2, 2)
assert coords.cshape == (2,)
npt_allclose = np.allclose(coords.get_cart()[0], np.array([0, 0, 0]))
assert npt_allclose
print('f2_slice_isolation', True)

triple.is_identity: new is not coords (slice owns a copy)
triple.shared_mutation_visibility: mutating the slice (set_cart) leaves coords' shape and values untouched

mechanism_evidence.contract: Reusable argument/option decorator factories never mutate the shared closure attrs mapping: each application owns its params; repeated applications yield identical classes; captured at the decorator-application timepoint.
mechanism_evidence.trigger: Apply the same cls= decorator factory to two commands.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: Inner decorator pops cls from the shared attrs dict; the second application silently gets the default class.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: cls promoted to an explicit factory parameter; inner decorator performs zero mutation of attrs.

triple.is_identity: foo.params[0] is not bar.params[0] (per-application owned params)
triple.shared_mutation_visibility: first application leaves the shared attrs mapping reusable (second sees cls)

mechanism_evidence.contract: BaseRequest.clone owns an independent url: the clone is not (is not) the original and its url is rebuilt from the new scheme/host; the original request url is untouched; captured at the clone() call timepoint.
mechanism_evidence.trigger: Clone a request with a new scheme/host, then compare urls.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: Clone refreshes only the scheme/host cache; clone.url keeps the original scheme/host.
mechanism_evidence.causal_change: Rebuild url via with_scheme/with_host and sync _cache in the constructor path used by clone().

discriminating_observation.description:
from aiohttp.test_utils import make_mocked_request
req = make_mocked_request('GET', 'https://example.com/path/to?a=1')
req2 = req.clone(scheme='http')
print('clone_identity', req2 is req, req2.url is req.url)
assert req2 is not req
assert req2.url is not req.url
assert req2.url.scheme == 'http'
assert req.url.scheme == 'https'
print('f2_clone_isolation', True)

triple.is_identity: req2 is not req and req2.url is not req.url
triple.shared_mutation_visibility: new scheme visible via the clone url only; the original url is untouched

mechanism_evidence.contract: Strategy caches are per-thread owned copies: each thread works on its own LRUReusedCache (is not another thread cache); cross-thread entries stay invisible; captured at the strategy-construction (cache-access) timepoint.
mechanism_evidence.trigger: Build strategies from two threads sharing the process.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: One global STRATEGY_CACHE dict is mutated from all threads; races raise inside cacheable.

discriminating_observation.description:
import threading
from hypothesis.strategies._internal.core import get_cache
main_cache = get_cache()
main_cache['f2probe'] = 1
seen = {}
def target():
    seen['cache'] = get_cache()
t = threading.Thread(target=target)
t.start()
t.join()
print('cache_identity', seen['cache'] is main_cache)
assert seen['cache'] is not main_cache
assert 'f2probe' not in seen['cache']
print('f2_thread_isolation', True)

triple.is_identity: per-thread cache is not another thread cache
triple.shared_mutation_visibility: entries written in one thread stay invisible to other threads

mechanism_evidence.contract: SmartCacheDataset owns a working copy of the input datalist when shuffling: the shuffled sequence is not (is not) the caller list; shuffling leaves the caller list order untouched; captured at the dataset-construction timepoint.
mechanism_evidence.trigger: Construct a SmartCacheDataset with shuffle=True over a caller-owned list.
mechanism_evidence.base_wrong_behavior: In-place randomize() shuffles the caller-owned datalist.

discriminating_observation.description:
import numpy as np
data_list = [np.array([i]) for i in range(5)]
before = [a.tolist() for a in data_list]
from monai.data import SmartCacheDataset
ds = SmartCacheDataset(data=data_list, transform=None, cache_rate=0.5, replace_rate=0.4, shuffle=True)
assert [a.tolist() for a in data_list] == before
print('f2_datalist_isolation', True)

triple.is_identity: working datalist is not the caller datalist
triple.shared_mutation_visibility: dataset shuffling leaves the caller list order untouched
